parsed_json.up: Select molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles for all molecules reported in the specified document. Source data from molecule_dictionary and compound_records, linking via molregno. Join with compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter by document CHEMBL ID equal to CHEMBL1125820. Sort the results by molecule_chembl_id in ascending order.
